title: What not to expect from an advisor
subtitle: Being confident about what this is worth means being straight about what it isn't.

text: I am not a discount. I'm an edit.
sub: The fare is the fare - the same or better than direct, never marked up. If the whole question is the lowest possible number on a screen, you don't need me.

items.head: Overrule the weather
items.body: Ports are dropped for swell and wind. I can plan around exposure; I can't promise a tender runs.

items.head: Beat a price that is real
items.body: If a number is genuinely lower for the same fare code and inclusions, I'll tell you to take it.

items.head: Make a large ship feel small
items.body: Some things are structural. The answer is a different ship, not a better cabin on this one.

items.head: Read your mind
items.body: The brief you give me is the ceiling on what I can do. Vague in, generic out - every time.

text: What to expect is a reply, and a reason attached to it.
sub: A short list with the reasoning shown, a fare I have negotiated, and one name on the file from the first email until you are home again.

quote: Every recommendation is one I'd be glad to defend over dinner.

left.label: Not this
items: A booking engine with a face

title: Save this before your next enquiry
body: To me or to anyone. Then write with where you are leaning and I'll come back with a short list worth your time, and the reasoning behind it.
